blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Joining forces for the first time, Alex Eala and Shaira Rivera showed no chemistry issues in their women’s doubles opener in the Asian Games 2026 on Tuesday night. The Filipino pair handled Hong Kong’s Ching Laam Lai and Kallista Liu, 6-1, 6-3, at Indoor Court B of the Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Nagoya to advance to the round of 16 after another rain delay.
